property_summary: For every input _val, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract stores MinSum equal to the provided _val; the mutant that assigns ~_val will cause MinSum != _val for any _val where ~_val != _val (i.e., for some inputs), so the invariant MinSum == _val is always true for the reference and broken by the mutant for some fuzzed _val.
change_summary: Negate the assigned value so MinSum becomes the bitwise NOT of _val, producing a different stored value after call.
